versions.changelog: Needs Jellyfin 12.4. The media list has a new Filters panel (library, watched, resolution, audio and subtitles, file issues) with removable chips, and a Sort menu with order and Group by codec; column headings sort too. Re-encode previews keep going while ffmpeg is working and stop only when it stalls, a GPU that hangs falls back to the CPU, timeout messages say what to try, and a failed preview has a Try again button.

Needs Jellyfin 12.4. The overview shows free space per disk, and each drive can be hidden in Settings. The encode list survives a restart, and failed or stopped encodes can be restarted. The scan tags likely file problems, which the list can filter by, and it can sort by resolution. Each new file is checked in full before it replaces the original, main audio is guarded, and track titles and languages can be tidied. Settings add recycling of originals, encoding hours, lower priority and default choices. GPUs that can't encode 10-bit fall back step by step, HDR to SDR offers four styles, and VA-API can decode on the GPU. Unlinked extras are filed under their movie's library.

Encoding and Clean up now roll up, and a new Customisation panel in Settings sets how each starts. Encoding stays on the page when the queue is empty, with an Empty tag. Clean up's tiles line up, and the Leftovers date has its own line. A new Library filter sits beside Sort on the same row as Search, replacing the library tabs. A language track that runs longer than the film no longer makes a correct encode look cut short.

name: Storage Optimizer
description: Scans every library and shows which folders and files use the most space. Re-encodes files to HEVC or AV1 with quality checks, remuxes out audio and subtitle tracks you don't need, converts audio, handles HDR, and finds duplicates, unwatched media and leftover files.
overview: See where your library storage goes and re-encode to save space
